scope: Bounded literature review; no new algorithm or rate theorem claimed.

paper.title: A Subexponential Time Algorithm for Elliptic Curve Discrete Logarithm

assessment: No blocking flaw found in the reviewed arithmetic and randomized reduction, conditional on the assumed OpenAI D.1 tensor-contraction theorem. The assumed theorem was not independently certified by this review.
comparison: ECDLP expected randomized 2^O(b/(log b)^(1/4)) does not improve the deterministic semiprime target 2^O(ell/sqrt(log ell)). The recursive acquisition algorithm is already specified in this repository; complete primitive-machine implementation and total runtime certification remain unfinished.
